steps.name: DESeq2 differential expression: treated vs control
caveats: 3 replicates per group is a low-power design: both DESeq2 and edgeR-style count models recover only a minority of true DE genes at n=3, biased toward large-effect genes. A gene absent from the significant list is not evidence of no effect. Do not loosen the FDR threshold to compensate.
counts.csv is already gene-level (not transcript-level Salmon quant.sf), so no tximport length-scaling offset is applied; state this explicitly rather than fabricate an offset step.
steps.context: 12000 x 6 raw counts, 3 vs 3, unpaired, single batch, Salmon/Ensembl Danio rerio gene-level counts (no transcript-level tximport object available — counts.csv is already gene-level, so the tximport length-offset step does not apply here; note this in the report).
steps.question: Which of the ~12000 zebrafish larval genes are differentially expressed between drug-treated and control larvae (adjusted p < 0.05), and what is their shrunken log2 fold change?

grounding.reason: DESeq2 Wald test with apeglm shrinkage is the grounded method for a fixed-effects, 3-vs-3, single-batch, raw-count design (R-0001@9a17); R-0017@8a47 requires the explicit power caveat at n=3.

constraints: min_count=10, min_samples=3 (smallest group size) pre-filter, minimal only — independent filtering in results() does the rest
alpha=0.05 passed to results() to match the reporting cutoff
apeglm shrinkage on the single treated-vs-control coefficient
count outlier policy: flag_and_report_na (do not disable Cook's distance filtering)
steps.description: Pre-filter to genes with >=10 counts in >=3 samples (the smallest group size). Build the DESeqDataSet with design ~condition, explicitly set 'control' as the reference level of condition, run DESeq() (median-of-ratios normalization is internal to the model — no separate normalization step), extract results() for the contrast condition_treated_vs_control at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering on, and apply apeglm shrinkage (lfcShrink, coef = the treated-vs-control coefficient) to obtain the shrunken log2FoldChange. Inspect and report the unadjusted p-value histogram before trusting the BH-adjusted values. Report any gene flagged as a Cook's-distance count outlier (padj set to NA) separately from genes removed by independent filtering.
acceptance_criteria: Reference level of condition explicitly set to control; contrast named as condition, treated, control

p-value histogram inspected and its shape reported

MA plot and dispersion plot produced as fit diagnostics

plan.title: Zebrafish larvae drug exposure DE + pathway analysis
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is 12000 x 7 raw Salmon gene-level counts (Ensembl Danio rerio annotation) for 3 drug-treated vs 3 control zebrafish larvae pools (metadata: 6 samples x condition, unpaired, single batch). The plan follows the grounded DESeq2 procedure for a 3-vs-3 unpaired two-group design with no batch: (1) sample-structure QC on a blind VST to check that the two conditions separate and no sample is an outlier before any test runs; (2) a minimal count pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, the smallest group size) followed by DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization built into the model, a Wald test on an explicit control-reference factor, apeglm shrinkage of the treated-vs-control log2 fold change, and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control with independent filtering at alpha=0.05; (3) because zebrafish has no curated MSigDB/WikiPathways collection, a ranked (preranked fgsea) enrichment on the full tested gene list, ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic, run twice — once against the zebrafish-native GO Biological Process annotation (org.Dr.eg.db, no ortholog loss) and once against the human MSigDB Hallmark + WikiPathways-human collections after a babelgene ortholog mapping (stating the mapped fraction and genes dropped) — so the two runs are triangulated rather than trusted singly; (4) an integrated report stating the replicate-count power caveat (n=3/group finds a minority of true DE genes, biased toward large fold changes), the annotation/ortholog caveats, fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), and full reproducibility record (session info, package versions, collection versions). No curated zebrafish-specific pathway database (KEGG, Reactome, WikiPathways-Dr) is staged in this environment, which the enrichment step will state explicitly as a limitation rather than substitute silently.

orthologs function usage species zebrafish Danio rerio taxonomy id

orthologs() function species argument human_only top_hit

~condition, explicit reference level = control, contrast treated_vs_control
apeglm shrinkage on the treated-vs-control coefficient
fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic, zebrafish genes mapped to human orthologs via babelgene, run against MSigDB Hallmark and GO BP human collections
Integrated DE + enrichment report with QC diagnostics, power caveat, ortholog mapping caveat
